additions.name: SCSK netXDC Chiba No.3 (SI3)

status.summary: SCSK’s netXDC SI3 is a commercial data centre on its Inzai campus in Chiba. Its October 1, 2026 operator report describes ongoing operations, with circulating-water free-cooling chillers, separated hot and cold aisles, two incoming power feeds, UPS and backup generators. SI3 began service in May 2022. October 1 is the report date; the site-visit day is unstated.

locator.precision: Google named SI3 facility marker within SCSK netXDC Inzai campus, used to locate the campus and its SI3 project. It is not a surveyed footprint, campus boundary, parcel boundary, entrance or server-room location. SI1 and SI2 are not separately mapped.
locator.identity_review: The operator report names SI3 within SCSK’s Inzai campus; the official campus page separately lists SI1, SI2 and SI3. The selected Google feature explicitly names SI3 and links that exact operator campus page. Its coordinate tuple is distinct from the Helsinki query viewport and the Street View camera point.
